Source & credits

The offline Pokémon bot was built with AI assistance using Pokémon Showdown’s open-source client and the @pkmn battle simulator. This site is a personal fan project, unaffiliated with Pokémon Showdown or the owners of Pokémon.

Download the browser edition’s source (about 24 MB). This includes the packaged September 2026 application source, the pinned upstream client, browser modifications, this website, and build instructions. Optional neural models are not deployed.

Application and Showdown client code uses AGPL-3.0. Preserve the third-party notices, artwork notices, and client license. Pokémon names and artwork retain their respective owners’ rights.

The browser edition supports local OU, Random Battle, and Random Doubles. Static graphics and silent play keep the download smaller. Physical phone performance has not been verified.

The math exercises are original AMC/AIME-style practice questions, not official contest material.
